integrity: Closed-form proof with standalone high-precision diagnostic checker; no external scientific certification. Existing model and known convexity boundary expressly excluded from new claim.
scientific_limitations: Exact constitutive arithmetic mean for two equal areas, not a nonlinear flow or effective-medium homogenization theorem. Full Fuentes et al. (1992) inaccessible; earlier equivalent publication possible. Negative fitted tortuosity may be nonphysical in some soils.
title: One-switch finite-amplitude averaging law for van Genuchten–Mualem soil conductivity
